content.text:
I fixed all three problems in `src/queue.js`, and `npm test` passes with 6 of 6 tests.

- **Hang after a failure:** a rejected job never freed its slot, so the queue stalled. Every job now frees its slot and starts the next one whether it succeeds or fails. A job that throws synchronously, or returns a plain value, is now handled the same way.
- **`onIdle()` resolving early:** it only checked that nothing was pending, so it could resolve while jobs were still running. It now waits until nothing is pending and nothing is running.
- **Slow after `pause()`/`resume()`:** `resume()` started only one job. It now fills every free slot, so concurrency 4 runs four at a time.

I added four regression tests to `test/queue.test.js`, one for each case above plus sync-throw and plain-value jobs.
